verdict.rationale: Aircall documents a broad public API: starting outbound calls, pausing and resuming recordings, retrieving transcriptions, summaries and sentiment, managing campaigns, sending messages, and webhooks. Nothing claims or shows parity with the UI, though. UI features such as IVR and business-hours routing, Queue Callback, the shared inbox and AI Agents have no documented API counterpart in the evidence, and there is no OpenAPI spec to check coverage against. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of IVR/routing configuration and Queue Callback, API control of AI Agents/Assistants, and a published machine-readable spec or independent corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Start an outbound call ... Dial a phone number in Aircall Workspace
Pause recording on a Call ... Resume recording on a Call
Retrieve a transcription ... Retrieve sentiments ... Retrieve topics ... Retrieve a summary
Create a Campaign ... Launch a Campaign ... Pause a Campaign ... Resume a Campaign
Use the Messages endpoints to automatically trigger SMS and automate outreach.
